sources: https://www.camplife.com/331/reservation/?newres=y (CampLife park 331: site types, availability and invoice quotes for 2027 dates)

values.note: 2027: back-in $70 / pull-through $80 nightly in the off season (April 15 - June 17, September 13 - November 1); peak (June 18 - September 12) back-in $110 weekday / $135 weekend, pull-through $130 / $145. Holiday weekends sell as three-night packages ($395 back-in, $425 pull-through) and the Folk and Jazz Festival weeks as four-night packages ($515 / $575); peak weekly $695 / $795. A site holds 2 adults and 3 children; 2 more adults in place of 2 children at $10 per adult per night. Stays of 14 days or longer pay metered electricity.

values.note: Holiday weekends (Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day, Columbus Day) are three-night minimums and the Folk and Jazz Festival weeks four nights; the engine asked 3 nights for mid-July 2027. note: Town of Portsmouth campground at the Melville Ponds recreation area on Aquidneck Island, a short drive north of Newport; leased to a private operator and run as Newport RV Park. Shaded wooded sites and open sites, Airstream glamping rentals, dog park, and trail access into the Melville Ponds area. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 2027 rates ($70-$145), added extra-person fee, CampLife booking (url, 2-night/holiday-3 minimums, check-in times), 30/50-amp full hookups, 113 sites (100 RV incl. 20 pull-through), showers/laundry/store/Wi-Fi/dump ($20). Season left unset: rate seasons run April 15 - November 1 but the homepage says 'Open May - October'. Not waterfront confirmed (sites 50 m+ from the pond through woods).
flags: SEASON (left unset, conflicting operator pages): the 2027 rate seasons run April 15 - November 1 and the dump is closed 'Nov 1 thru Apr 15', but the homepage banner says 'Open May - October' and tents run April 15 - October 15. The engine also offered single nights at $65 on 2026-12-08 and 2027-03-16 (premium F sites), so it is not a clean closed season. A human may set opens 04-15 / closes 11-01 from the rate page.

WEBSITE: http://www.melvillepondscampground.com/ redirects (200) to https://newportrvpark.com/, the operator's site; suggest storing https://newportrvpark.com/ first. The Portsmouth town page (second URL) answers and says the campground is 'leased by a third party'.
PHONE: 401-682-2424 confirmed (Google Maps listing 'Newport RV Park' and the operator's site). Google Maps: 4.3 stars, 372 reviews, 181 Bradford Ave, Portsmouth.

LONG-STAY CHECK: passes. About 100 RV sites sold nightly online (98-100 open on every 2027 shoulder date tried, 93 in mid-July); seasonal campers are mentioned only in the camp rules (bucket washing 'for seasonal campers ... with approval').
PRICE GATE: base $70 off season (back-in); peak back-in $110 weekday, $135 weekend, so over US$50 in summer and at the off-season base. Newport (about 15 km) is the gateway for the 40 km exception.
MAX RIG: the engine lists Back In sites at maxLength 40 and Premium pull-throughs at 50; the premium description says 'up to 45 ft' and the park description 'up to 60 feet'. max_rig_ft left unset.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront: confirmed): on the RIGIS 2023 orthophoto the nearest RV row sits ~50 m west of the pond through a wooded strip, with no open apron.
OWNERSHIP: local (Town of Portsmouth land, leased to the private operator 'Newport RV Park, A Mill Point Company'); unchanged.
